BINANCE USDT Perpetual — L2 Order-Book Deltas + Trades (2026)
	

Raw market-microstructure tick data for BINANCE USDT-margined perpetual
futures: full-depth L2 order-book deltas and trades, as zstd-compressed
Parquet. Recorded by the goldmine market-data recorder; converted losslessly from
its internal GMKT v1 format.
This repo holds year 2026. Data is sharded one repo per exchange per year
(mktdata-binance-<year>) to keep per-repo file counts and size bounded.
